dedupe_keys.name: meteorological forcings and reservoir operations data for plstm reg v1 0 conus

description: Bin Yu, Yanan Chen and Yi Zheng publish forcing and operations data for 256 reservoirs in the contiguous United States. Zenodo serves two ZIPs and a README under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Catchment-averaged Daymet precipitation and minimum and maximum air temperatures are daily series for 1990–2023; the companion operation files include net inflow, storage, outflow and water elevation keyed by reservoir identifier. These data train and test the related PLSTM-Reg release and can calibrate other reservoir-release simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this paired 256-reservoir bundle. A limitation is that gridded Daymet originals are not redistributed, and catchment averaging removes within-basin climate variation. The operations series derive from a prior HydroShare dataset with separate source attribution. Neither ZIP was downloaded, so reservoir coverage, missing days and unit conversions were not independently checked.
